title: 2v2 Plus One Neutral Player
description: A 2v2 game with a neutral player who always joins whichever team has the ball, creating a constant 3v2 advantage that rewards good spacing.

content.objective: Use a constant numbers advantage well by finding and involving the neutral teammate.
content.setup: Two teams of two play live, with one neutral player always playing offense for whichever team has the ball.
instructions: Play live, with the neutral player joining the attacking team the moment possession changes.
The attacking team should use the extra player to create an open shot, not ignore them.
On a turnover or defensive rebound, the neutral player immediately switches to the new attacking team.
Rotate the neutral player role every few minutes.
coachingPoints: Involve the extra player early in the possession, don't save them for a last resort.
Keep good spacing so the three-on-two advantage is actually usable.
Transition mentally fast when possession changes — know your new role immediately.
commonMistakes: Ignoring the neutral player and playing a cramped 2v2 anyway.
Standing around after a turnover instead of reacting to the new matchup.
Ignoring the game's constraint once the pressure is on.
content.safety: Keep contact controlled; call fouls to maintain a fair pace.
